intro.narration: [excited] Fifty-five squared, minus thirty squared, in your head, before you reach for a pen.

steps.narration: [confident] The rule. A squared minus B squared equals A plus B, times A minus B.
[thoughtful] Add them. Fifty-five plus thirty is eighty-five. Subtract. Fifty-five minus thirty is twenty-five.
[excited] One multiplication left. Eighty-five times twenty-five is two thousand, one hundred twenty-five.

outro.narration: [warm] Save this, and try it on your own two squares.
